name: Michigan

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Retake at a later date; contact a Secretary of State branch for scheduling

gdl.permitMinAge: 14 yrs 9 mo (Level 1, after driver education Segment 1)
gdl.nightCurfew: Level 2: no unsupervised driving 10 p.m.-5 a.m. (employment and authorized exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: Level 2: no more than 1 passenger under 21 (with exceptions)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and legal presence (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Proof of a valid Social Security Number
Proof of Michigan residency (typically two documents)
Minors: proof of driver education completion (Segment 1/Segment 2 certificate)
process.realIdNotes: Michigan offers a REAL ID-compliant license (star in a circle). Bring identity/legal-presence, SSN, and Michigan residency documents.
process.permitFee: $25 (adult Temporary Instruction Permit; teen GDL licensing may differ)
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.bacLimitAdult: 0.08% (0.17% triggers enhanced High BAC 'Super Drunk' penalties)
facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in 2 years can trigger a driver reexamination and possible suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, if safe, move over one lane for stopped emergency, tow, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph (75 mph on some posted rural freeway segments)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: As posted (commonly 25 mph when children are present)

references.label: What Every Driver Must Know
references.citation: Michigan SOS 'What Every Driver Must Know' (SOS-133, 2025 ed.)

references.label: Impaired Driving Law
references.citation: Michigan State Police / OHSP Impaired Driving Law; MCL 257.625

verifyNote: Current Michigan SOS sources confirm adult online availability and fees but do not publish the exact operational knowledge-test question count or passing count; 50/40 remains unconfirmed.
